chars.SISTER: a Moroccan young woman of about 20 with long dark wavy hair, wearing a bright red satin party top, black high-waist jeans and gold hoop earrings
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her 50s wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.DAD: a Moroccan father in his late 50s with a grey moustache, wearing a beige cardigan over a white shirt
chars.MAN: a Moroccan man in his early 30s with a trimmed black beard, wearing a black leather jacket, white t-shirt and a silver watch

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a modest Casablanca family apartment. SISTER tiptoes toward the front door holding her heels in one hand, glancing back nervously, caught mid-step; seen from the dark staircase where the witness stands. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm lamp light. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SISTER stands in front of her bedroom mirror applying bold red lipstick, schoolbooks and a baccalaureate certificate pushed aside on the desk, rebellious smirk. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, subject centered.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Daytime living room with Moroccan sofas: MOM watches suspiciously from the kitchen doorway while SISTER, bored, scrolls her phone on the sofa with free time on her hands. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night outside a trendy Casablanca cafe-lounge with neon lights: SISTER laughs with two stylish new girlfriends, one of them handing her a cigarette, glasses on the table. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, main subject centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SISTER proudly walks into the family living room holding the arm of MAN, who carries a bouquet; she smiles excitedly, he looks confident. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Family living room: SISTER, determined, faces DAD and MOM who sit stunned on the sofa; she gestures that she wants to marry quickly. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Simple Moroccan wedding night: SISTER in a white and gold caftan beside MAN in a dark suit under a decorated arch, guests blurred in background. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Their small new apartment: MAN watches TV on the couch while SISTER, now in the red satin top again, looks out of the window at the city lights, restless and bored. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance: SISTER puts on her jacket and grabs her handbag heading out, telling MAN she is going out with her friends; MAN stands up from the couch, frowning in disbelief. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical.
